major_cooldowns.name: Trueshot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown together with your potion, on-use trinket and racial, and hold the fight's last one until Bullseye reaches 30 stacks.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 288613 is both the cast and the self aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Volley
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, since it grants Trick Shots for its whole duration and makes your Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire cleave for free.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 260243 is the cast id; 260247 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Explosive Shot
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it on cooldown and press it a second time inside the Unstable Trigger window, sending that second cast at another target in AoE so the set bonus cuts your cooldowns twice.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 212431 is the observed cast and target-aura id; 212680 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Moonlight Chakram
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Trueshot becomes this button for Sentinel, so fire it with about 5 seconds left on Trueshot where it will not push back your other priorities.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1264949 is the cast id; 1264902 is the talent node and 1264946 the self aura. No base cooldown in game data because Trueshot grants the cast, so 120s mirrors Trueshot.

major_cooldowns.name: Wailing Arrow
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Trueshot becomes this button for Dark Ranger, so fire it inside the window whenever Black Arrow is not ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 392060 was not observed in the sampled parses, which all played Sentinel, but the guide lists it as the Dark Ranger Trueshot replacement button. Cooldown mirrors Trueshot's 120s since Trueshot grants the cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pop it inside Trueshot, where a stat buff is worth the most, rather than the moment it comes off cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Raid trinket on-use, cast in 4 of 5 parses; talent_gated so players on other trinkets are not flagged.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-pot just before the pull so it covers your opening Trueshot, and drink the second one inside a later Trueshot.

major_cooldowns.name: Harrier's Cry
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the raid's assigned burst window, and pair it with your own Trueshot when no timing is called so you gain the haste too.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 466904 cast in 2 of 5 parses; talent gated raid haste buff.

rule.description: Explosive Shot, Volley, then Trueshot into Rapid Fire
rule.action: Open with a pre-cast Aimed Shot, then Explosive Shot twice into Volley, then Trueshot with your potion and trinket, then Rapid Fire.
Follow every Aimed Shot with Arcane Shot, swapping to Multi-Shot on a pack or Kill Shot once the target is in execute range.

rule.description: Second Explosive Shot inside Unstable Trigger
rule.action: Press Explosive Shot again on the very next global while Unstable Trigger is up, at a second target when you have one.

rule.description: Keep Hunter's Mark on your target
rule.action: Mark your primary target before the pull and reapply it the moment it drops, splitting targets with the other Hunters.

rule.description: Multi-Shot only as your AoE Precise Shots spender
rule.action: Save Multi-Shot for packs, where it also keeps Trick Shots up, and spend Precise Shots with Arcane Shot on a lone target.
Hold your on-use stat trinket for the Trueshot window instead of pressing it the moment it is ready.
